title: How do diameter, cap and finish affect paper tube packaging quotes? - MUGE PACKAGING SourceBridge

buyer_question: How do diameter, cap and finish affect paper tube packaging quotes?
buyer_context: cosmetics, candles, tea, fragrance, specialty retail and premium small-product packaging
short_answer: A quote-ready brief should give the supplier enough context to review structure, material, print and packing direction before pricing. For paper tube packaging, MUGE PACKAGING recommends sending diameter and height, cap or closure style, inner fit, product weight, print and finish direction, plus artwork status and the target market.
